claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound.
claims.evidence: Photos show appearance only; no audio test or functional verification.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices for good...
claims.evidence: No visible ports/connectivity or pairing/AUX/USB details in the provided photos.
A blue light is visible, but button functionality is not testable from photos.
No adapter/cable is shown in the photos.
No proof of purchase/location is shown.
No sound test or control test is shown.

risks.risk: Speakers may not be working properly (low volume, distortion, intermittent driver issues).
risks.proof: A short audio test clip: play the same track at low/medium/high volume from a phone/laptop and show both speakers producing clear sound with no crackle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst-case: reduced functionality).

risks.risk: Missing or incompatible power adapter/cable (UK purchase may not match Nigeria voltage/plug).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/cable included (label showing voltage/current and plug type) plus a clip showing it powering the speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer must source power).

risks.risk: Connectivity/inputs may be limited or faulty (Bluetooth not pairing, AUX/USB not working).
risks.proof: Clip showing pairing/connection (Bluetooth screen or pairing confirmation) and/or a working AUX/USB connection with audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as connectivity uncertain (worst-case: only one input works or none).

risks.risk: Physical condition may hide damage (scratches, dents, loose drivers, worn controls) not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides and the control panel/ports, plus a quick shake/fit check showing drivers are firmly mounted.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible condition (appearance-only, no guarantee of durability).

risks.risk: Model/label may not match the actual working unit (label text partially readable; could be mismatched pair).
risks.proof: Photo of both speakers’ labels clearly showing the same model/side designation and (if available) serial numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential mismatch/uncertainty about exact model.

proof_requests: Show the adapter/cable included (photo of the adapter label and plug type) and confirm it powers the speakers.
Provide a short sound test clip from a laptop/phone showing both speakers at low/medium/high volume with no crackle.
Show connectivity working: Bluetooth pairing confirmation and/or AUX/USB input test with audio.
Take clear close-up photos of both speakers’ labels/serial numbers and the full control panel (buttons/knobs).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type and model from the visible labels/markings, so a worst-case price is possible even though functional claims (sound, buttons, adapter, connectivity) are not verifiable from photos.
